title: mariscus umbellatus
intro: Mariscus umbellatus, commonly known as "Chinese Marsh Cane" or "Umbrella Plant", is a type of aquatic plant native to East Asia, characterized by its umbrella-shaped inflorescence. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus umbellatus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and relax the respiratory system. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
